title: Maximum Frequency of an Element After Performing Operations II
summary: Given an integer array nums, integers k and numOperations, perform numOperations operations where each operation involves selecting an unselected index and adding an integer in the range [-k, k] to the element at that index.
statement: Given an integer array nums, integers k and numOperations, perform numOperations operations where each operation involves selecting an unselected index and adding an integer in the range [-k, k] to the element at that index. The goal is to find the maximum frequency of any element in nums after all operations are completed.
constraints: nums has 1–100,000 values in 1..1,000,000,000; k is nonnegative and num_operations is at most len(nums).
Each index can be selected at most once and changed by an integer in [-k,k].
Return the maximum achievable frequency without iterating across the numeric coordinate range.
hints: Only interval boundaries and original values can change the best target calculation.
Use a sparse difference map so billion-sized coordinates do not affect runtime.
Add +1/-1 reachability events and zero events at original values; sweep sorted coordinates.
Between events reachability and existing frequency are unchanged, so evaluating exactly these sparse points covers every optimum.
